shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package-lock.json | head -30 && node --version && npm --version && git log --oneline | head
npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest && npm install -D typescript @types/node @types/react @types/react-dom 2>&1 | tail -5 && cat package.json
npm install -D typescript@^5 2>&1 | tail -2 && npx tsc --version && npx next --version
mkdir -p data && touch data/.gitkeep && npm test 2>&1 | tail -20

sed -i 's|await fs.readFile(booksFile(), "utf8")|await fs.readFile(/*turbopackIgnore: true*/ booksFile(), "utf8")|; s|await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true })|await fs.mkdir(/*turbopackIgnore: true*/ path.dirname(file), { recursive: true })|; s|await fs.writeFile(tmp, JSON|await fs.writeFile(/*turbopackIgnore: true*/ tmp, JSON|; s|await fs.rename(tmp, file)|await fs.rename(/*turbopackIgnore: true*/ tmp, file)|' lib/books.ts && grep -n turbopackIgnore lib/books.ts && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "warn|error|Static analysis|Route|├|└|┌"

rm -f data/books.json && (PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && \
echo "--- home (empty)" && curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE "Nothing on the go[^<]*|No finished books yet" && \
echo "--- add form" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/new && \
echo "--- 404" && curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/books/does-not-exist
HTML=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/new) && echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION[^"]*"( value="[^"]*")?' | head

HTML=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/new)
A10=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_1:0" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/' | sed 's/"/"/g')
KEY=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_KEY" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/')
echo "--- submit with empty author (expect validation error)"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/books/new \
  --data-urlencode '$ACTION_REF_1=' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_1:0=$A10" --data-urlencode '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=' --data-urlencode 'notes=' | grep -oE 'class="error">[^<]*'
echo "--- submit valid book (expect redirect to /books/<id>)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST localhost:3123/books/new \
  --data-urlencode '$ACTION_REF_1=' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_1:0=$A10" --data-urlencode '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=Frank Herbert' --data-urlencode $'notes=Spice must flow.\nSecond line.' | grep -iE "^HTTP|^location"
echo "--- on disk"; cat data/books.json

HTML=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/new)
A10=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_1:0" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/' | sed 's/"/"/g')
KEY=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_KEY" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/')
echo "A10=$A10"; echo "KEY=$KEY"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/books/new \
  --data-urlencode '$ACTION_REF_1=' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_1:0=$A10" --data-urlencode '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' --data-urlencode "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  --data-urlencode 'title=Dune' --data-urlencode 'author=Frank Herbert' --data-urlencode 'notes=x' | head -c 1500; echo; tail -20 /tmp/next.log

HTML=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/new)
A10=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_1:0" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/' | sed 's/"/"/g')
KEY=$(echo "$HTML" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_KEY" value="[^"]*"' | sed -E 's/.*value="([^"]*)"/\1/')
echo "--- empty author (expect validation error)"
curl -s -X POST localhost:3123/books/new -F '$ACTION_REF_1=' -F "\$ACTION_1:0=$A10" -F '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' -F "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=' -F 'notes=' | grep -oE 'class="error">[^<]*'
echo "--- valid (expect redirect)"
curl -s -o /dev/null -D - -X POST localhost:3123/books/new -F '$ACTION_REF_1=' -F "\$ACTION_1:0=$A10" -F '$ACTION_1:1=[{}]' -F "\$ACTION_KEY=$KEY" \
  -F 'title=Dune' -F 'author=Frank Herbert' -F $'notes=Spice must flow.\nSecond line.' | grep -iE "^HTTP|^location"
echo "--- on disk"; cat data/books.json

ID=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("data/books.json","utf8"))[0].id)') echo "--- home shows it under Currently reading" curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '

[^<]*

|class="title">[^<]*|

[^<]*' echo "--- detail page" PAGE=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID) echo "$PAGE" | grep -oE '[^<]*|<h1>[^<]*|by [A-Z][^<]*|Reading since[^<]*|Mark as finished|class="notes">[^<]*' echo "--- mark finished (multipart POST of that form)" AID=$(echo "$PAGE" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/name="([^"]*)"/\1/') curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3123/books/$ID -F "$AID=" -F "id=$ID" curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID | grep -oE 'Finished [0-9][^<]*|Mark as finished' echo "--- home now" curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '<h2>[^<]*</h2>|class="title">[^<]*|<p class="empty">[^<]*' echo "--- restart server" pkill -f "next start"; sleep 1; (PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &); sleep 4 curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID | grep -oE '<h1>[^<]*|Finished [0-9][^<]*' grep -c '"status": "finished"' data/books.json
pgrep -fl "next-server|next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; pkill -f "node.*next start" ; sleep 1; pgrep -fl "next" || echo "server stopped"
ps aux | grep -v grep | grep -E "next" | awk '{print $2, $11, $12, $13, $14}'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:3123/ || true

(PORT=3123 npx next start > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4 ID=$(node -e 'console.log(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("data/books.json","utf8"))[0].id)') echo "--- after restart: home" curl -s localhost:3123/ | grep -oE '

[^<]*

|class="title">[^<]*|

[^<]*' echo "--- after restart: detail" curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID | grep -oE '

[^<]*|Finished [0-9][^<]*' | head -2 echo "--- edit notes" PAGE=$(curl -s localhost:3123/books/$ID) AID=$(echo "$PAGE" | grep -oE 'name="\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+"' | head -1 | sed -E 's/name="([^"]*)"/\1/') curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST localhost:3123/books/$ID -F "$AID=" -F "id=$ID" -F "notes=Finished it. Loved the ending." grep -o '"notes": "[^"]*"' data/books.json; ls data/
for p in $(ps -eo pid,args | grep -E "next (start|-server)" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $1}'); do kill $p; done; sleep 1; rm -f data/books.json; ls -la data; git status --short
